Alɩf, Lɑɑm, Mɩɩm.
Woto yaa Gafã Aaya-rãmb sẽn bʋ n manege.
A yɑɑ sor-wilgr lɑ yolsg mɑɑn-neerã rãmb yĩngɑ.
Neb nins sẽn yãnesd ne Pʋʋsgã la b kõt Zakã la b maand bãng-n-wãak ne Yaoolem raarã.
Bãmbã n be kãndgr zug la bãmb me lɑ põsdbã.
Lɑ bee nebã pʋgẽ neb sẽn dɑɑd reem goɑm bʋɩl yĩng tɩ b na menes n bɑs Wẽnd sorã tɩ kɑ yɩ ne bãngr ye, lɑ b rɩk-ɑ ne wɩsga, bãmbã lɑ naong yɑɑndgã be b yĩngã.
Lɑ b sã n kɑrem Tõnd goɑmã ɑ zug lɑ ɑ sẽn gũt a kuidg (kẽngd n loog) t'ɑ yɑɑ wɑoog-m-meng soɑb tɩ yɑɑ wɑ ɑ pʋs n kɑ wʋm-ɑ ye, bɩ f kõ-a kibar ne nan-zɑbdgɑ.
Bãng-y tɩ sẽn kõ-b sɩdã lɑ b tʋm tʋʋm-sõmã wã, arzãn sẽn yaa neemã be b yĩngɑ.
B yɑɑ pɑɑdb ɑ pʋgẽ, yɑɑ Wẽnd pʋleng sẽn yɑɑ sɩdɑ, lɑ Yẽnda lɑ Zɩsg n yaa Bʋʋd-Mitɑ.

A nɑɑnɑ sɑɑsã tɩ pa tũ ne ra-tεεdga tɩ yãmb ne-a ye, lɑ A ning tãms Tẽngã pʋgẽ bʋɩl yĩng lɑ ɑ rɑ miim ne yãmb ye, lɑ A sẽeg bõn-yãnemdg buud fãɑ ɑ pʋgẽ, lɑ A sik koom tɩ yi sɑɑgẽ wã t'A buls bũmb sẽn tɑr wɑoor buud fãɑ.
Wẽnd naanegã lɑ woto, bɩ y wilg mɑɑm zẽng sẽn kɑ Yẽ wã sẽn nɑɑn wɛ! Ad yɑɑ wẽgdbã n be meneng pʋgẽ bala.
Lɑ sɩdɑ Tõnd kõo a Lʋkmɑɑn bʋʋd minim: "pʋʋs Wẽnd barka, ned ning sẽn pʋʋsa barka yaa a meng yĩng bɑlɑ; lɑ ned ning sẽn kɩfla bɩ y bãng tɩ Wẽnd yɑɑ sek-m-meng-soɑb n yɑɑ pẽgr Naaba".
Tẽeg wakat ning a Lʋkmɑɑn sẽn wɑ n yeel ɑ biigã, ɑ sẽn wɑ n sɑgend-ɑ wã: "m biigɑ, ra maan lagem-n-taar ne Wẽnd ye, ad lɑgem-n-tɑɑr yɑɑ wẽgb sẽn bedme".

La Tõnd sɑglɑ ninsɑɑl ne ɑ roɑgdb ɑ yiibã mɑnegre, ɑ mɑ wã zɩ-a lame ne ninbãaneg sẽn pʋg ninbãanega, lɑ ɑ yẽsengã yɑɑ yʋʋm ɑ yiib pʋgẽ: "bɩ f soees Maam la f roɑgdb ɑ yiibã, Mɑm nengẽ lɑ y nɑ n lebg n wɑ".

Lɑ b yiibã sã n pẽdg foom tɩ f lɑgem Mɑɑm ne bũmb fo sẽn kɑ tɑr ɑ bãngre, bɩ f rɑ tũ-b ye, lɑ tũ b yiibã dũni pʋgẽ ne mɑnegre, lɑ f tũ ned ning sẽn lεbg-ɑ n wɑ Mɑm nengẽ wã sorã. Rẽ poorẽ Mɑm nengẽ lɑ y lebgr zĩiga, tɩ M togs-y y sẽn dɑ yɩ n tʋmdẽ wã.
M biig sõngo! Baa bũmb sã n zems wala goandg biiga, n tɩ be pĩig pʋgẽ, mɑɑ sɑɑsẽ wã, mɑɑ Tẽngã pʋgẽ, Wẽnd wɑtɑ ne-ɑ, ad Wẽnd yɑɑ Bãng-pẽk Nɑɑbɑ n yaa kiba-Mita.
M biig sõngo! Yɑls Pʋʋsgo, sɑgl ne mɑnegr lɑ f gɩdg ne wẽnga, lɑ f mɑɑn sugr ne sẽn pɑɑm-fo, ad woto naaga yel-bεdã.
Lɑ f rɑ wẽnemd f yεgdg n kɩs nebã ye, lɑ f rɑ kẽn Tẽngã zug ne tɩtaam ye, ad Wẽnd kɑ nong wɑoog-m-meng soɑb n yaa fʋʋs-m-meng soab ye.
Lɑ f mɑɑn zem-zem f kẽnã pʋgẽ lɑ f sik f koεεgã, ad koees sẽn yɩɩd wẽng yɑɑ bõens koεεgɑ.

Rẽ yĩngɑ yãmb kɑ yẽ tɩ Wẽnd nomɑ sẽn be sɑɑsã pʋsẽ lɑ Tẽngã zug n kõ yãmba, lɑ A kõ-y A neema-rãmb tɩ gale yɩng lɑ pʋgẽ? Lɑ bee nebã pʋgẽ neb sẽn wẽed no-koeemd Wẽnd yellã zug tɩ kɑ yɩ ne bãngr lɑ sor-minim lɑ gaf-vẽnegd ye.
Lɑ sã n yeel-ba: "tũ-y Wẽnd sẽn sikã". Lɑ b sẽn yete: "d tũudɑ d sẽn mik d bɑɑbɑ-rãmbã sẽn rɑ tũud bũmb ningã". Rẽ yĩngɑ bɑɑ tɩ sã n yɑɑ ɑ sʋɩtãan n boond bãmb n dɑbd Sa'ʿɩɩr Bugmẽ wã b nɑ pʋg-bɑ?
Lɑ ned ning sẽn wɑ n pelg ɑ pʋg ne Wẽnde n yɑɑ mɑnegdɑ, rẽnd ɑ gãda rɑodg sẽn yɩɩd ne pãngɑ, lɑ yɑɑ Wẽnd nengẽ lɑ yεlã fãɑ lebgr zĩigɑ.
Lɑ ned ningɑ sẽn mɑɑnɑ sõm-zɩtem bɩ ɑ sõm-zɩtmã rɑ wɑ sãɑm fo sũur ye. Tõnd nengẽ lɑ b lebgr zĩig tɩ D wilg-b b sẽn tʋmã. Ad Wẽnd mii sẽn be sũyẽ wã.
D wʋmsgd-b-lɑ noog bɩlf bɑlɑ, rẽ poorẽ tɩ D kẽes-b naon-taok pʋgẽ.
La fo sã n sok-ba "ãnd n nɑɑn sɑɑsã lɑ Tẽngã". B na yeele: "yɑɑ Wẽnde". Bɩ f yeele: "pẽgr yɑɑ Wẽnd n so". Pa woto ye, b wʋsgã fãa kɑ mi ye.
Lɑ sẽn be sɑɑsẽ lɑ Tẽngẽ yɑɑ Wẽnd soolem, ad Wẽnde, Yẽ lɑ sek-m-meng Soɑb n yɑɑ pẽgr Soɑbɑ.
Baa tɩ Tẽngã zug tɩɩsã fãa sã n da yaa gʋls-moodo [n na n gulse], baa tɩ mogrã sã n lebg rʋba, tɩ b leb n paas-a mog a yopoe, kõon n sek Wẽnd goɑmã gʋlsg tɩ sε ye, ad Wẽnd yɑɑ Windɑ n yɑɑ Bʋʋd-Mitɑ.
Yãmb [fãa] naanegã lɑ yãmb vʋʋgrã kɑ yɩ rẽndɑme tɩ yɑɑ wɑlɑ yõor ɑ yembr bɑlɑ, ad Wẽnd yɑɑ Wʋmd n yɑɑ Netɑ.

Rẽ yĩngɑ fo kɑ bãng tɩ Wẽnd kẽesdɑ yʋngã wĩndgã pʋgẽ lɑ A kẽesd wĩndgã yʋngã pʋgẽ lɑ A nom wĩntoogã lɑ kiuugã t'a yembr fãɑ zoet n gũud sɑsɑ b sẽn yãk n dɩglã, lɑ f leb n kɑ bãng me tɩ Wẽnd yɑɑ kiba-Mit ne yãmb sẽn tʋmdã?
Woto, tɩ bala yaa Wẽnd la sɩda la bãmb sẽn tũud bũmb ning zẽng sẽn pa Wẽndã, yẽ la zĩri wã, la ad yaa Wẽnd la zẽk wagell Naaba.
̌̌̌̌̌̌̌̌̌̌̌Fo kɑ yã tɩ koglgã zoetɑ mogrã zug ne Wẽnd neemã wã bʋɩl yĩng t'A wilg yãmb A yel-soɑlmã kẽere, ad yel-soalem bee rẽnda pʋgẽ ne sug-mɑɑnd fãa sẽn yaa bark pʋʋsda.

Lɑ ko-wiuug sã n yɩk n lug be b yĩngrã wɑlɑ mɑɑsem lɑ b sẽn boond Wẽnd n yɩlgd b tũudmã ne-A; lɑ A sã n wɑ n tɩlg-b n yi yɩngã lɑ b kẽerã sẽn lebg tɩtaam rãmba (kɩɩsdɑ); lɑ kɑ kɩɩsd Tõnd yel-soɑlmã rẽndɑ yel-sõm-zɩt la zãmb-bedr soaba.

Nebã! Zoe-y Wẽnd lɑ y zoe rɑɑr ningɑ biig sẽn kɑ nɑ n yaoog ɑ roɑgd tɩ roɑgd me kɑ nɑ n yaoog ɑ biig bɑɑ fʋɩ wã; ad Wẽnd pʋlengã yɑɑ sɩdɑ, bɩ y gũus tɩ dũni vɩɩmã rɑ wɑ belg yãmb ye, lɑ y gũus tɩ bεlgdã (sʋɩtãanã) me rɑ wɑ belg yãmb tɩ y bɑs Wẽnd ye.
Ad yaa Wẽnd n tɑr dũni wã yikr bãngre; Yẽ me n sikd sɑ-koom lɑ A mi sẽn be (pag) rogsẽ. Yõor kɑ mi ɑ sẽn nɑ n pɑɑm beoog ye, yõor kɑ mi ɑ sẽn nɑ n ki tẽng ning ye, ad Wẽnd yɑɑ Bãngd n yɑɑ kiba-Mika.
